content_html:
Some of the most useful home upgrades are not the most expensive ones. The best buys tend to solve a small recurring problem, save time or make an everyday task easier.

Some links in this article are affiliate links. We may earn a commission if you make a purchase, at no extra cost to you.

1. Milk frothers

A compact milk frother can be worthwhile if you regularly make coffee at home. Before buying, check whether it heats as well as froths, the usable capacity, how easy the inside is to clean and whether the whisk is removable.

Compare current milk frother listings on eBay UK

2. Smart plugs

Smart plugs can add timers and app control to lamps, fans and other suitable appliances. Look for clear power ratings, compatibility with your preferred smart-home platform and reliable scheduling. Avoid using one with equipment that the manufacturer says should not be remotely switched.

Compare current smart plug listings on eBay UK

3. Heated clothes airers

A heated airer can be useful when outdoor drying is impractical. Compare its folded size, running power, drying area and whether a cover is included. It will not replace good ventilation, so keep moisture management in mind when drying laundry indoors.

Compare current heated clothes airer listings on eBay UK

Which is most useful?

Choose the product that solves a problem you already have rather than buying purely because it is on offer. Check the exact model, seller feedback, delivery costs, warranty and returns policy before purchasing.

Prices, offers and availability change regularly. Always check the live listing and specifications before purchasing.
